coverage.summary: Residential rental property within Santa Ana city limits. The available secondary sources state no unit-count, building-age or owner exemptions. The ordinance is structured to operate alongside existing and proposed state antitrust laws rather than displace them.

result.notes: Removed other_conditions. The exclusions for software relying solely on public or aggregate historical data, and for affordable-housing compliance tools, define which landlord tools and conduct are prohibited. They do not describe which buildings, units or owners are covered, so they belong under exemptions, not coverage. Removed the citation to Cal. Bus. & Prof. Code § 16729 from the summary because no document contains it. DX19 says only 'existing and proposed state antitrust laws.' Reworded the no-exemptions statement to make clear it reflects the available secondary sources. The ordinance text itself is not in the record, so size, age or owner exemptions in the actual ordinance cannot be ruled out. D084 and D085 concern the separate rent stabilization and just cause ordinances. Their construction cutoff (after February 1, 1995) and 15-year new-construction exemption do not apply to NS-3090.
